def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Extend the diagonal color code periodically. Its period is the grid width
    # in these examples; known diagonal offsets carry the seed colors.
    period = w
    offsets = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, v in enumerate(row):
            if v:
                offsets[(c-r) % period] = v
    # Propagate the seeded diagonal colors; untouched diagonal offsets remain 0.
    return [[offsets.get((c-r) % period, 0) for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
PY
